notes:
Summary:
- Enterprise code search + internal knowledge RAG. Heavy focus on embeddings + reranking to surface exact code snippets and API usages.
- Corpus: ~3M files (12M code snippets), growing. Daily commits -> ~200k snippet updates/day. Frequent incremental re-indexing required.
- Desired infra: private deployment (VPC) with option for on-prem full airgapped later. Must support Okta SAML SSO and detailed audit logs.

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Latency targets: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 150ms, p99 <= 300ms for search + top-k rerank (cross-encoder).
- Throughput: baseline 1k qps, peak 4k qps (CI bursts + developer activity spikes).
- Cost sensitivity: target avg cost-per-query (embedded retrieval + rerank) <$0.012; ops wants knobs (cache, quantized models, batching).
- Indexing: incremental + near-real-time updates; prefer shard hot/cold separation; ability to apply partial re-embeds for changed snippets.
- Storage & vector index: currently experimenting with FAISS HNSW on infra and looking at Redwood Optimize suggestions for quantization/profiles.
- Reranking: bi-encoder retrieval then cross-encoder rerank. Concern about cross-encoder cost at scale — exploring small distilled cross-encoders or cached candidate reranks.
- Model preferences: open models only for now (Llama2 variants, Mistral small), evaluating Redwood verified profiles for latency/cost.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass security questionnaire (submitted 2026-02-25). Legal insists on data residency controls for EU employees.
- Require KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for embeddings at rest.
- Retention controls: dev data must be deletable via API per retention policy.
